Tell me in about 200 words why people in India are switching to UPI, with a short list of 3 reasons
2:03 AM

People in India are switching to UPI because it is faster, cheaper and easier than cash, cards or old-style bank transfers. Not long ago, sending money meant carrying change, remembering account numbers and bank codes, or hoping a shop took cards. Now a phone number or a QR code is enough, and the money reaches the other person's bank account in seconds, at any hour, even on holidays.

Three main reasons:

It is simple: Scan, type the amount, approve with your PIN. No card, no change, no account details to remember.
It costs little or nothing: Paying friends or most shops is usually free, so even small vendors and street sellers are happy to accept it.
It works almost everywhere: One bank account can link to many apps, and from a chai stall to a big store, nearly every shop shows a QR code.

Trust has grown too. When your chai seller, your landlord and your friends all use it, paying this way simply feels normal. Each payment needs your own PIN, which adds to the comfort. Early cashbacks and strong backing from banks and the government gave it a push, and daily habit did the rest.

Make a table comparing 3 budget phones under 20000 rupees
2:04 AM

My pick for best value under ₹20,000 is the Poco X6 5G at ₹17,999. The iQOO Neo 9 SE is the one to choose if speed matters most, and the Realme Narzo 70 Pro if photos do.

Poco X6 5G, ₹17,999
Chip: Snapdragon 7s Gen 2
Screen: 6.67” AMOLED, 120Hz
Camera: 64MP with OIS, 16MP front
Battery: 5100mAh, 67W charging
iQOO Neo 9 SE 5G, ₹19,999
Chip: Snapdragon 7 Gen 3 (the strongest of the three)
Screen: 6.78” AMOLED, 120Hz
Camera: 50MP with OIS, 16MP front (average in low light)
Battery: 5000mAh, 120W charging
Realme Narzo 70 Pro 5G, ₹18,499
Chip: Dimensity 7050
Screen: 6.67” AMOLED, 120Hz
Camera: 50MP Sony with OIS, 16MP front (the best camera of the three)
Battery: 5000mAh, 67W charging (plastic build)

All figures come from one buying guide, last updated 22 Oct 2026. Shop prices may differ, so check the final price before you buy.
